title: Smoky Slovakian Tofu Bowl
description: A hearty, smoky Slovakian-inspired bowl filled with marinated tofu and a variety of vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, olive oil, and Slovakian smoked paprika (if using). Add the tofu and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the tofu from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
While the tofu is cooking, heat some olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion, bell pepper, and carrot, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked brown rice on the bottom, followed by the marinated tofu and sautéed vegetables.
Garnish with your choice of toppings, such as chopped fresh herbs or a dollop of sour cream.
